result.summary: Wrote r3/lit.md (239 lines) covering the 4 literature questions in r3/analysis.md for seed 804: (1) intraday volume-timing as persistent characteristic vs. time-varying signal (core ① day_centroid(sqrt(Volume))) — key new finds: Llorente-Michaely-Saar-Wang (2002 RFS) volume-return dynamics vs. informed-trading share, Cremers-Mei (2007 RFS) systematic/idiosyncratic turnover decomposition, Daniel-Grinblatt-Titman-Wermers (1997 JF) characteristic-matched (within-bucket) benchmarks, Boehmer-Jones-Zhang-Zhang (2021 JF) retail-trade identification, Shen-Shi (2020 SSRN WP) passive ownership -> close-weighted intraday volume (direct investor-base proxy, strength grows over time with passive share), Yang (2022) China last-hour return momentum. (2) Closing-auction/last-half-hour share (core ②, N idea 2) — Bogousslavsky-Muravyev (WP dated 2019-11, publ. 2023 JFM) closing auction ~7.3% of 2018 US volume tied to ETF/institutional rebalancing, price-discovery-neutral, overnight-reverting; Comerton-Forde-Putniņš (2011 JFI) manipulation index method; Han-Zhao-Chen-Guo (2022 Pacific-Basin Finance J.) China's 2018-08-20 SSE closing-auction natural experiment, effects concentrated in small caps. (3) Minute |return| kurtosis / zero-return ratio / price discreteness (core ③) — Amaya et al. kurtosis direction (positive, weak, reused from r2's already-verified PDF read), Barndorff-Nielsen-Shephard (2003 WP/2006 JFEctrcs) RV-BV jump decomposition as a concrete separation tool, Bollerslev-Todorov (2011 JF) jump tail risk pricing, Lesmond-Ogden-Trzcinka (1999 RFS) ZERO liquidity measure, Bekaert-Harvey-Lundblad (2007 RFS) ZERO measure prices emerging-market returns (positive direction), Münnix-Schäfer-Guhr (2010 Physica A/arXiv 2010-01) tick-size distorts return tails/correlations at small intervals. (4) Non-monotonic size exposure and subtracting differently-scaled quantities (R-2) — Lee-Qu-Shen (Stanford GSB WP 2017-09) China shell-value absorbs the size premium, Chang-Hong-Liskovich (2013 NBER/2015 RFS) Russell index-inclusion threshold price discontinuity, Daniel-Titman (1996 NBER/1997 JF) characteristic-balanced portfolio method, Horowitz-Loughran-Savin (1996 WP) spline estimate of size-return shape (unstable year to year), and a cross-domain (non-finance) composite-indicator methodology paper (Kaiser-Chen-Gluckman, 2020-08 arXiv) on scale-dominance when combining differently-scaled indicators without standardizing. All 20 sources dated/confirmed before 2023-08-08 and marked verified:true; explicit "could not find" notes recorded for claims that lack direct literature support (e.g., no formula linking minute-kurtosis bias to zero-return ratio; no finance-specific discussion of subtracting differently-scaled characteristics). Cross-referenced r1/lit.md and r2/lit.md at the top of the file to avoid redundant searches on material they already covered (Admati-Pfleiderer/HKS/Gao/Blau theory, Amaya skewness direction + 5-minute sampling rationale, Barra Non-linear Size, conditional-sort methodology).
